summary: Prototype Standard/Spark Rules tested in an isolated Firestore Emulator: 55 permission/transaction probes passed. Safe for review, not yet a finished paid-chapter or multi-account economy release. Production Rules remain unchanged.

findings.issue: The existing EPUB document layout makes every chapter readable by anyone while the parent book is published. Hiding a paid chapter in the browser does not enforce a purchase.
findings.recommendation: Design a private paid-content path, verified entitlements, and a server-issued purchase operation before enabling paid EPUB reading. Retain the existing publication behavior until the migration is ready.

findings.issue: The legacy profiles_v2 currency and inventory remain owner-editable for backward-compatible solo progress. Their values cannot prove a real balance or item ownership.
findings.recommendation: Treat profiles_v2 as display/sandbox progress only. Keep economy_accounts_v52 client-write denied and use trusted, idempotent server operations before exchange/trades.

findings.issue: Each public EPUB metadata document includes ownerUid, importFingerprint, sourceName and other importer details. Firestore Rules cannot selectively redact fields from an allowed document read.
findings.recommendation: In a later content-schema migration, separate public catalog metadata from private author/import metadata. Avoid sensitive local filenames in sourceName.

findings.issue: Unknown fields already present in older owner-only profiles are tolerated to avoid breaking existing saves and resets; nested list/map elements are not fully validated.
findings.recommendation: After backing up and examining real profile field shapes, migrate to an exhaustive validated schema. No privileged decision may consume a profile field.

findings.issue: The CLI session has no authenticated access to the real Firebase project. Only the demo emulator was used; the candidate has not been deployed or checked against live documents.
findings.recommendation: Before a one-time console update, export production Rules/data, verify both EPUB document schemas and profile optional fields, review diff, then deploy only after trusted exchange and paid-chapter design is finalized.
